incomplete.sampleSummary: Element content contains only non-text characters
incomplete.note: All 15 incomplete nodes are TrendArrow glyph-only spans (▲, ▬, ▼). The elements carry aria-label="Trend: <direction>", role="img", and title attributes per WAI-ARIA, which is the correct accessibility pattern for icon-only content. axe-core flags as 'needs human review' because it cannot auto-compute contrast for pure-glyph content without surrounding text. This is an axe limitation, not a real violation.

howToReproduce: 1. Open https://sawatter.github.io/canada-under-carney/ in Chrome. 2. Open DevTools console. 3. Paste: const s = document.createElement('script'); s.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/axe-core/4.10.2/axe.min.js'; document.head.appendChild(s); 4. After it loads, paste: await axe.run(document, { runOnly: { type: 'tag', values: ['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21aa'] } }); 5. Inspect the result object.
